# FitOne.pro

> FitOne.pro is an early-stage health technology startup building an intelligent wellness ecosystem that turns everyday health signals into clear, personalised next actions.

Website: https://fitone.pro/
Contact: connect@fitone.pro
Language: English (India)
Founded: May 2026
Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
Founder: Deepakchandar T

## What FitOne is building

- Personal health intelligence that combines activity, nutrition, goals, health history and behavioural patterns.
- Personalised motivation and simple next actions based on each user's evolving context.
- A Health Wallet that turns consistent healthy actions into points, challenges and rewards.
- A feedback intelligence layer that converts user experiences into structured insights for wellness brands.
- Smart fitness vending as a physical access point within the wider FitOne ecosystem.

## Why Claude is core to the product

FitOne plans to use Claude as a reasoning and intelligence layer, not as a standalone chatbot. Claude will interpret product and nutritional information, answer user questions, generate explainable recommendations from stated preferences, and analyse anonymised machine feedback and inventory trends. FitOne does not diagnose conditions or prescribe treatment.

## Current stage

FitOne is in active early-stage development. The website contains interactive product demonstrations and clearly labels illustrative data. It does not present demo values as verified user traction.

The public website prototype does not request or store personal health information. Any future account-based collection will require explicit consent and an updated data policy before launch.
